title: What's New in v2.9.61
notes: 🔕 Pure Attention-Driven Bell Menu: Empty sections (leadership announcements, staff notices, or feedback) now automatically disappear completely when there is nothing needing attention.
🎉 Seamless All Caught Up State: When no announcements, staff directives, expired tokens, or unread posts exist, the notification modal presents a clean 'All Caught Up' view without any empty boxes.
🛡️ Dedicated Leadership Tools Access: Leadership broadcast and countdown scheduling remains instantly accessible via the top-right Staff Tools pill button.
